objective: Correct the generic contract between AI-produced Report Design, deterministic measure resolution, guardrails, PBIP compilation, validation and incremental trace evidence without scenario-specific production logic.
requirements: APBRA-138 Generic Report Design Measure Resolution and PBIP Reference Integrity
acceptance_criteria: Every declared and visual-referenced measure has a unique canonical identity and complete supported expression contract before PBIP compilation.
Ratio and percentage operands resolve deterministically; supported derived measures are normalised without arbitrary free-text DAX.
Incomplete or unsupported measures stop before compilation with a truthful review or unsupported outcome, context and recommended action.
No unresolved measure reference survives into candidate generation or deterministic candidate validation.
Trace evidence is persisted incrementally so completed retrieval, citation and guardrail work remains truthful after a downstream failure.
The ServiceNow funnel is regression input only; production logic contains no report, measure, filename, KPI or page special case.
The repaired flow is verified through automated coverage and a real live end-to-end Foundry run before completion is claimed.
verification_required: Focused measure-resolution, compiler, validation, workflow and RAG regression tests
Full web test suite and production build
Hosted secret scan and fresh independent review
Live GPT-4.1, governed RAG, guardrail, compiler and candidate-validation execution
Haseeb Power BI Desktop validation of any newly generated candidate
out_of_scope: Scenario-specific ServiceNow, StagePctOfTotal, report-name, filename, KPI or page logic
Dependency, schema-ingestion, RAG algorithm, governed corpus, PDF, styling, backend, environment or security-model changes
Arbitrary DAX generation from free text or silently dropping unsupported measures
Production deployment or claiming Power BI Desktop success without Haseeb confirmation
escalate_when: Source contradiction or implementation scope expansion
A required path is outside the exact allowlist
A derived expression cannot be represented and validated by the bounded compiler
Live Foundry, RAG, build, bootstrap, secret scanning or independent review is unavailable
actual_authenticated_actor: Codex governance execution via haseebulhaque authenticated GitHub connection
dependencies: APBRA-12 Capstone Evaluation & Demonstration parent authority.
